paper_title: AI Scientists Fail Without Strong Implementation Capability
caption: Analysis of AI Scientist publications on arXiv. The upper panel displays the average number of citations up to now, categorized by containing implementation details. The lower panel shows the growth in the total number of these papers with the same categorization.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the total number of publications from AI scientists on arXiv, categorized by whether or not they include implementation details. The x-axis, labeled ‘Winter ‘24’ to ‘Spring ‘25’, represents time in years and quarters, with tick intervals of approximately three months, beginning at Winter ‘24 and ending at Spring ‘25. The y-axis, which is linear, ranges from 0 to 21, with unitless values, and is labeled ‘Quantity’ and displays tick intervals of approximately 2 units. A solid blue line, representing ‘Without Implementation’, begins at the point (2, 2), continues in an increasing trend, and ends near the point (15, 18). A dashed aqua line, representing ‘Without Implementation’, starts at the point (0, 7), increases steadily to reach the point (12, 13), and continues to rise, reaching the point (15, 18). A dotted orange line, representing ‘With Implementation’, commences at the point (0, 3), increases steadily to reach the point (12, 13), and continues to rise toward (15, 21).
